en.topic_title: China restricts exports to 14 EU entities citing national security concerns
en.topic_summary:
China banned exports of products with the potential for dual civilian and military uses to 14 European Union companies on Friday, citing national security concerns.



File photo: Gov’t EU.



The move comes a day after the EU imposed similar export restrictions against 51 new entities, including Chinese and Hong Kong companies, which it accused of supporting Russia’s war in Ukraine.
